name: Crédit Agricole S.A.
tagline: Acting every day in the interest of our customers and society
company_description: Crédit Agricole S.A. provides retail and corporate banking, insurance, and investment banking products and services in France, Italy, rest of the European Union, rest of Europe, North America, Central and South America, Africa, the Middle East, the Asia Pacific, and Japan. It operates in five segments: Asset Gathering, Large Customers, Specialized Financial Services, French Retail Banking  LCL, and International Retail Banking. The company offers savings/retirement, death and disability/creditor/group, and property and casualty insurance products; asset management; investment solutions; banking products and services, savings, wealth management, payment, cash flow management, and online banking services; personal finance and mobility; and specialized financial services. It also provides investment banking, structured finance, international trade finance, commercial banking, capital market, and syndication services; leasing, factoring, and energy and territorial financing; and asset servicing solutions for investment products, as well as various asset classes, such as execution, clearing, forex, security lending, custody, depositary banking, fund administration, middle-office outsou

description.long_fr: Crédit Agricole SA est l'entité cotée du groupe Crédit Agricole, premier financeur de l'économie française. Le groupe couvre la banque de proximité (LCL, banques régionales), la gestion d'épargne et d'assurances (Amundi, Crédit Agricole Assurances), les services financiers spécialisés et la banque de financement et d'investissement (CACIB). Le groupe sert ~54 millions de clients dans 47 pays.
description.long_en: Crédit Agricole SA is the listed entity of the Crédit Agricole group, France's top financer of the economy. The group covers retail banking (LCL, regional banks), savings and insurance (Amundi, Crédit Agricole Assurances), specialised financial services and corporate and investment banking (CACIB). The group serves ~54 million customers in 47 countries.
description.long_de: Crédit Agricole SA ist das börsennotierte Unternehmen des Crédit Agricole-Konzerns, dem größten Finanzierer der französischen Wirtschaft. Der Konzern deckt das Filialbankgeschäft (LCL, Regionalbanken), das Spar- und Versicherungsmanagement (Amundi, Crédit Agricole Assurances), spezialisierte Finanzdienstleistungen sowie das Finanz- und Investmentbanking (CACIB) ab. Der Konzern betreut rund 54 Millionen Kunden in 47 Ländern.

hero_kpi_rationale: Produit net bancaire annuel : 22,66 Mds € en 2021 -> 28,08 Mds € en 2025, soit +23,9% en quatre ans et un troisieme record annuel consecutif, avec une croissance portee par les cinq poles. C'est l'agregat que Credit Agricole S.A. met en avant en tete de communique et le socle du plan ACT 2028, alors que le RNPG marque le pas en 2025 (-0,2%) sous l'effet de la premiere consolidation de Banco BPM.

kpis.signal: 28,1 Mds € en 2025 (+3,3%), record annuel, troisieme record consecutif

kpis.description_en: Crédit Agricole S.A. consolidated net banking income as published each year. 2021 under IFRS4 (2021 URD), 2022 restated under IFRS 17 as published in the 2023 press release.
